matches.title: Norwich City vs Milton Keynes Dons
matches.description: Watch Norwich City vs Milton Keynes Dons highlights and goals from Carabao on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 8, 2026. On August 8, 2026, football fans gathered for a high-stakes Carabao Cup encounter that promised plenty of action from the opening whistle. The knockout nature of the competition set the stage for an intense battle between two sides eager to progress to the next round. A Fast Start for the Canaries Norwich City wasted no time establishing their dominance at home, striking within the first minute of play. Mohamed Touré found the top right corner with a clinical right-footed shot following a clever setup by Kenny McLean . The momentum stayed firmly with the hosts, and by the 7th minute, they doubled their lead. Anis Ben Slimane capitalized on another Touré involvement, slotting a right-footed effort into the bottom right corner to stun the visitors early on. The pressure from the home side remained relentless throughout the first half. Just before the break, in the 43rd minute, Ben Chrisene added a third goal for Norwich , firing high into the center of the net after being played in by Andre Brooks . The MK Dons struggled to find a foothold as the first period ended with the hosts firmly in command. Second Half Drama and Final Flourish The second half introduced a wave of drama when MK Dons were awarded a penalty in the 54th minute after Pelle Mattsson fouled Callum Paterson . However, Norwich goalkeeper Vladan Kovacevic produced a brilliant save to deny Nathaniel Méndez-Laing from the spot. The visitors did find a way back momentarily in the 56th minute, as Ryan Wintle converted from close range following a corner to make it 3-1. Any hopes of a comeback were swiftly extinguished just three minutes later. Andre Brooks got on the scoresheet himself in the 59th minute, finding the bottom corner to restore the three-goal cushion. Despite late efforts from MK Dons and several saves by Kovacevic in stoppage time, Norwich City maintained their composure to secure a convincing 4-1 victory and advance in the tournament.

matches.title: West Ham vs Portsmouth
matches.description: Watch West Ham vs Portsmouth highlights and goals from Carabao on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 8, 2026. The stage was set for a compelling night of football on August 8, 2026, as West Ham United hosted Portsmouth in a highly anticipated Carabao Cup fixture. Fans gathered in anticipation of a classic cup tie, with both teams eager to prove their worth and secure a place in the next round of the competition. Early Pressure and the Opening Blow Portsmouth entered the contest with no fear, immediately testing the Hammers' resolve. After an early flurry of corners and a blocked attempt from Colby Bishop , the visitors found their breakthrough in the 33rd minute. Following a corner, Adrian Segecic pounced on a loose ball outside the box and unleashed a precise left-footed strike into the bottom left corner, leaving Mads Hermansen with no chance and giving the underdog supporters a reason to dream. However, the lead acted as a wake-up call for West Ham United , who responded with a devastating scoring burst late in the first half. In the 43rd minute, Mohamadou Kanté found Valentín Castellanos in the center of the box, and the striker made no mistake, firing into the top right corner. The momentum shifted entirely when, in stoppage time, Jarrod Bowen took center stage. Assisted by Pablo , Bowen struck a powerful left-footed effort from distance to flip the game on its head and send the hosts into the break with a 2-1 lead. Castellanos Seals the Deal The second half began with the Hammers looking to put the game out of reach, and they did exactly that in the 50th minute. Jarrod Bowen turned provider, delivering a pinpoint cross that Valentín Castellanos met with a powerful header into the center of the goal. The brace for Castellanos gave West Ham United a comfortable two-goal cushion and forced Portsmouth into a series of tactical changes, including a triple substitution that saw Odin Bailey and Marezi enter the fray. Despite the deficit, Portsmouth continued to fight, with Adrian Segecic forcing another save from Hermansen and Eoin Kenny missing a narrow chance from the center of the box. As the clock wound down, West Ham managed the game professionally, with James Ward-Prowse and Joël Veltman adding fresh legs to the midfield and defense. Pablo nearly added a fourth in the final minute, hitting the post, but the 3-1 scoreline remained intact, confirming a professional and well-earned victory for the London side.

Cardiff City , however, showed immediate character. They clawed their way back when Yousef Salech coolly converted a penalty in the 29th minute. As both teams hunted for the winner, the breakthrough finally arrived in the 77th minute. Jack Moylan rifled a clinical right-footed shot into the top corner following a swift Cardiff City counter-attack. The closing stages saw Swindon push hard despite James Debayo being sent off for a second yellow card, but the home side stood firm to secure their place in the next round.

Before the home crowd could catch their breath, Jack Rudoni doubled the lead in the 5th minute, finishing a move started by Awoniyi to put Plymouth Argyle on the ropes early in the contest. matches.title: Birmingham vs Brentford

The Carabao Cup clash between Birmingham City and Brentford promised to be a high-stakes encounter under the stadium lights. Both sides looked to establish their rhythm early on, knowing that clinical finishing would be the deciding factor in this knockout tie. Early Exchanges and Instant Response On August 25, 2026, Brentford wasted no time in asserting their dominance. Just 6 minutes into the match, Callum Wilson broke the deadlock with a precise right-footed strike from outside the box, assisted by Yehor Yarmoliuk . Birmingham City refused to back down and fought their way back into the game in the 28th minute. Demarai Gray unleashed a brilliant effort from distance following a set-piece situation, beating Hákon Valdimarsson to level the scores at 1-1. Brentford Pull Away The equilibrium was short-lived as the visitors regained control before the break. In the 35th minute, Aaron Hickey found the bottom corner with a left-footed finish to restore Brentford 's lead. The momentum stayed with the Bees , and in the 40th minute, Nathan Collins rose highest to head home a Jaidon Anthony cross, making it 1-3. Birmingham tried to respond through Gray and Luis Vázquez , but they couldn't find a way past the organized away defense. Second Half Dominance The second period saw Brentford turn a comfortable lead into a comprehensive rout. After a flurry of substitutions, the goals continued to flow. Mikkel Damsgaard added a fourth in the 70th minute following a lightning-fast break, once again assisted by Jaidon Anthony . Minutes later, Igor Thiago made it 1-5 from close range. The final blow arrived in the 77th minute when Nathan Collins secured his second header of the night from a corner, sealing a emphatic 1-6 victory for the top-flight side.
